cause: smoke_then_train.slurm hardcoded config:0 for preflight and training while smoke read the YAML seed. Existing-output guards prevented seed-0 overwrite.
fix: Read and validate the YAML seed once; use it for both pack preflight and trainer. Smoke already reads that same YAML seed.
validation: Three shell-wrapper integration tests and three packed-runner tests passed locally. Tests cover seed 1 with an existing seed 0 result, default seed 0, invalid seeds and existing target rejection.
